hero.alt: Thirteen volunteers in green Welfare Avenue vests pose under the green tent in a leafy park.

WEEK 1.title: Get set up
learn: Set up your Welfare Avenue accounts: Google, Chrome, Slack and Loom
Find your way around the Hub and your team's page
Read our policies, and check in and out every time you work
WEEK 1.why: Everything at Welfare Avenue runs through these tools. A week spent setting them up well saves you hours later, and it means your team can reach you.

WEEK 2.title: Who we are
learn: Tell our story and our mission in your own words
Use our brand and the words we use for the people we serve
Do your first work in the Hub
WEEK 2.why: You represent Welfare Avenue at servings, in messages and online. Knowing where we come from and how we speak means you represent us well.

WEEK 3.title: Your team
learn: Know how your team works and meets
Choose your first servings and confirm them
WEEK 3.why: This is where you start contributing: your team, your tasks, and your first serving. Every member volunteers four times a year: it is how you understand our work and do your role better.

WEEK 4.title: Look back
learn: Show what stuck in two short quizzes
Look back on your first weeks in a self-assessment
Sit down with your lead and HR for your 30-day evaluation
WEEK 4.why: A moment to check what stuck, say what could be better, and plan what comes next with your lead.

60 DAYS.title: Grow
learn: Understand how Canadian charities work, receipts included
Pick a Learning Avenue to grow in
Meet one of our co-executive directors
60 DAYS.why: Onboarding ends, growing does not. These steps set you up for the months ahead.
